description:
Connected social accounts. list: every account with the ids and names to publish with (YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads, Facebook, Bluesky, Pinterest, 3Speak, Rumble, Fanvue). connect: starts the connection of a network (an OAuth link to open, or a direct connect for Bluesky, 3Speak and Rumble). disconnect: removes an account. get_persona_publishing / set_persona_publishing: the accounts a persona publishes to by default (set replaces the whole set and must keep at least one). list_boards: the boards of a Pinterest account.
Actions and their required fields: list (no required fields); connect (provider); disconnect (account); get_persona_publishing (persona); set_persona_publishing (persona, accounts); list_boards (account).

accessToken.description: Rumble 40-character Simple Upload API access token (issued by emailing bd@rumble.com). Required only for rumble. Never shared or logged.

account.description: The account to disconnect, by name or id (accounts list shows both).

accounts.description: Publishing accounts the persona is bound to, per provider, e.g. { youtube: ["UC..."], bluesky: ["did:plc:..."], '3speak': ["alice"] }. Replaces the whole set: providers mapped to [] (or omitted) keep no binding for that provider, but the binding as a whole must keep at least one account (issue #572). Account IDs come from accounts (action: list) (channelId / igUserId / providerAccountId / did).

action.description: What to do: list | connect | disconnect | get_persona_publishing | set_persona_publishing | list_boards. The description lists the fields each action needs.

appPassword.description: Bluesky app password (Settings > App passwords). Required only for bluesky. Never shared or logged.

channelId.description: Rumble channel ID. Required only for rumble.

handle.description: Bluesky handle (e.g. user.bsky.social). Required only for bluesky.

persona.description: The persona, by name or id (personas list shows both).

postingKey.description: Hive posting key (the posting key only — never the owner, active, or master password). Required only for 3speak. Never shared or logged.

provider.description: Only the accounts of this network.

username.description: Hive username (e.g. alice). Required only for 3speak.

name: accounts
